sources.name: X / Twitter
sources.result: No qualifying new research found in sampled posts
sources.scope: We sampled a Latest search for cited researchers and a separate search for iOS exploit and release posts since November 5. A VideoToolbox post referred to research already tracked. These searches were bounded and do not cover all posts.

sources.name: GitHub
sources.result: Watched repositories match their reviewed baselines
sources.scope: All seven watched repositories match their reviewed commits and releases. No upstream review issues are open. Bounded searches for iOS exploit, proof of concept, jailbreak and kernel repositories found no qualifying new research. These searches do not cover all GitHub releases.
